title: Drake Confirms That 'Her Loss' Was A Part Of Trilogy & Shares It In His Top Three Projects That He's Done
htmlContent:
In a resurrected conversation, Drake officially confirmed that his 21 Savage LP Her Loss collaboration is the final installation of an album trilogy comprising Certified Lover Boy and Honestly, Nevermind.

“We got CLB, Certified Lover Boy, that was like the, you know, I’m trying my best to make her love [me], I’m chasing you,” Drake shared in new audio via Twitter. “And then Honestly, Nevermind is the realization that maybe that lifestyle is not for me.

“Then Her Loss is like ‘No Pigeons,'” he continued. “Remember when [Sporty Thievz] dropped ‘No Pigeons’ when [TLC] had ‘No Scrubs’ out?”

While many fans had already noticed the progress of the themes covered throughout the three albums, the interview is the first time that Drake speaks of the link between the LP series.

When calling CLB, Honestly, Nevermind, and Her Loss a trilogy, it seems that Drake will likely close the series that and move on to new concepts in his next album when he can show up.'

Drake also referred to Her Loss, which just dropped on November 4,

“one of the greatest albums I ever made in my life.”

“I said the other day, I think this is a clear entry into my top five of my catalog … if not top three.”
